hook.text: Hotmail added one line to every email: 'Get your free email at Hotmail.' It grew to 12 million users.

buildup.text: The viral coefficient (K) = invites sent × conversion rate. If K > 1, growth is self-sustaining.

discovery.text: Hotmail's K was above 1. Every new user brought in more than one additional user through their emails.

twist.text: Most products have a K far below 1. They need paid marketing to grow. True virality is extremely rare.

climax.text: WhatsApp achieved K > 1 by being better when friends joined. The product improved with each invite.

punchline.text: The best growth engine is the product itself.

quiz.question: What did Hotmail add to every outgoing email to grow virally?
